categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and touches CMakeLists.txt and cmake/secp256k1.cmake to propagate hardening flags to secp256k1.
categories.rationale: Fixes binary hardening integrity where missing flags on secp256k1 objects cause final binaries like bitcoind to lose hardware control-flow markers (e.g. AArch64 BTI/PAC/GCS or x86_64 CET). Per description, 'the three secp256k1 objects are the only ones in the build tree without the control flow property, so master's bitcoind has no AArch64 feature note', directly impacting release binary security properties.
